cash_breakdown.item: HKD and USD cash and cash equivalents
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Currency note shows HKD cash RMB70.704m and USD cash RMB0.338m. These balances are more movable than PRC RMB cash, but 2023 annual report also discloses unused listing proceeds earmarked for 2024 business uses, so not treated as 100% immediately detachable.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash on bank balance and likely held by listed/offshore group after Hong Kong IPO.

cash_breakdown.item: RMB cash and cash equivalents held by PRC operations
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report states RMB is not freely convertible and RMB balances are held by PRC subsidiaries. No parent/subsidiary split or quick dividend evidence was disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially excess cash, but PRC subsidiary cash has dividend, tax and foreign exchange friction and must partly support operations.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: All bank and other borrowings are deducted at 100%; RMB107.950m is due within one year and RMB10.990m within one to two years.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financing liabilities must be repaid or assumed by the controlling buyer.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Retained roughly two months of core cash operating needs given RMB234.747m revenue, project/media supplier settlement, and large receivable/payable swings.
cash_breakdown.reason: Removing this cash could impair continuing branding, advertising placement and event execution operations.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Small additional reserve for PRC-to-offshore dividend, FX and execution friction not fully captured by item haircuts.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash is split across RMB, HKD and USD and the annual report does not prove frictionless extraction.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Receivables are operating working-capital assets, not cash or low-risk funds assets.
cash_breakdown.reason: Large balance affects cash conversion but is not counted as detachable cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Operating property leases are necessary for continuing business and are reflected in profit/cash quality instead of mechanically deducted from cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Not treated as a liquidation burden under the continuing-operation owner-earnback view.

profit_quality.assessment: The accounting profit is not a strong proxy for distributable cash. FY2023 net profit was RMB64.983m and adjusted profit was about RMB80.728m after adding back listing expenses, but operating cash flow was only RMB23.887m. FY2022 operating cash flow was negative RMB29.258m. Trade receivables increased by RMB148.670m in FY2023 and trade payables increased by RMB76.991m, so 2023 cash flow still benefited from supplier financing while customer cash collection lagged.
adjustments: Used three-year adjusted net profit figures from the annual report financial summary: 2021 RMB29.9m, 2022 RMB50.4m, 2023 RMB80.7m; median pre-haircut sustainable profit is RMB50.4m.
Did not use FY2023 adjusted profit as the sole denominator because the company listed in November 2023 and cash conversion was weak.
Deducted/discounted for poor working-capital conversion rather than only listing it as a limitation.
FY2023 purchase of plant and equipment RMB3.866m is used as maintenance capex proxy; larger intangible/equipment prepayments are treated as growth or platform investment signals.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: FY2023 operating cash flow / adjusted profit is about 0.296; FY2022 operating cash flow was negative.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Receivable-heavy project/media service model, weak two-year operating cash flow support, and meaningful supplier-payable financing justify a large haircut.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Weak; profits were not consistently converted to operating cash.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex not separately disclosed; FY2023 PPE purchase of RMB3.866m used as conservative proxy.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Major reinvestment/lock-up in receivables: trade receivables increased RMB148.670m, partly offset by trade payables increase RMB76.991m.

limitations: Cash is not split by parent company, Hong Kong holding company and PRC operating subsidiaries beyond currency disclosure.
RMB cash held in PRC subsidiaries is not freely convertible and quick dividend ability is unproven.
Annual report gives no separate restricted cash line; lack of disclosure is not treated as proof of free extractability.
The profit denominator relies on limited listed-company annual data; 2021 full cash flow is not in this annual report.
Market cap is the historical rough-screen signal value from 2024-05-27, not current market cap.
